design.decision: Choose which five cards to pass: consolidate winners in one hand, strip a would-be nil bidder of honors, or create a void.
design.opponent: Revealed at Opening; opponents should expect one partner to be lopsided, often a nil plus a big bid.
design.rationale: Near-duplicate of seed-swap by count; the three-card seed measured flat (-0.3), so a larger swap tests whether enough movement turns the decision into real standalone value at the same price.
